hero.story1: Ten years ago I wrote my first Hello World. For a decade I explored the different layers of computer science, learning by doing and by failing. The answer I found was not some development stack. It was a way of seeing.
hero.story2: Python and SQL are the languages in which I think through pipelines, embeddings and agents. TypeScript is the one I chose for this portfolio. What connects the three is not the tools themselves, but the philosophies that run through all of them: test-driven development and data-oriented architecture. Writing tests first forces you to think before you act. Designing around data forces you to understand the problem before choosing a solution.
hero.story3: I am an active member in Mexico's AI ecosystem, actively sharing knowledge, attending events, and working alongside communities that help more people and businesses take the step toward technological integration.
